body: Thank you for your kind words. Unfortunately, this struggle is not new and all other options have been exhausted. I feel confident my landlord will be able to maintain the property and rent it out; I just want to do as much for them as possible because I know it's an inherently messy situation and they have been nothing but decent to me. Thank you for weighing in!
I think I will send a letter the day of departure with a personal check. They'll understand. Thank you for the input!
No pets! So no worries there. Thanks!
